lines.line: Eleven empires invaded this small land. Guess who stayed.
722 BCE. Assyria takes the north and deports its people.
586. Babylon burns the Temple and exiles Judah.
In 70 CE, Rome burns the Second Temple.
In 135, it crushes the last revolt and renames the land.
In 1488, a rabbi counts seventy Jewish families in Jerusalem.
The Ottomans. Their tax records count about seven thousand Jews.
By the 1880s, fifteen to twenty four thousand.
Britain. Its census: 84,000 Jews in 1922. 175,000 in 1931.
Many peoples lived here too, and their history is real.
Every empire left. The Jewish people never did.
If you love Israeli facts, follow Noam Roz for more.
So count them again. Eleven empires.

transcript.heard: 11 empires invaded this small land. Guess who stayed? 722 BCE. Assyria takes the north and deports its people. 586. Babylon burns the temple and exiles Judah. 539. Persia lets them rebuild. Then Alexander. Then Rome. In 70 CE Rome burns the second temple. In 135 it crushes the last revolt and renames the land. Byzantium. The Caliphate. Crusaders. In 1488, a rabbi counts 70 Jewish families in Jerusalem, the Ottomans. Their tax records count about 7,000 Jews. By the 1880s, 15-24,000. Britain. Its census, 84,000 Jews in 1922, 175,000 in 1931, 1948, independence. Today about 7.3 million. Many peoples lived here too, and their history is real. Every empire left. The Jewish people never did. If you love Israeli facts, follow the Amraz from more. So count them again, 11 empires.
